}; const enabled = (el) => visible(el) && !el.disabled && el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') !== 'true'; const textOf = (el) => ((el && (el.innerText || el.textContent)) || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); return countdown.classList.contains('end') || text.includes('0 seconds') || text === '0'; }; const fire = (target, type, x, y) => target.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(type, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window, clientX: x, clientY: y })); steps.code: const wait = (ms) => ctx.wait(ms); const log = async (message) => { if (ctx.log) await ctx.log('[Enderbit Ouo] ' + message); }; const notifyId = '5878981847'; const notifyStep = 50; const notifyKey = 'enderbit_earn_ouo_last_notify_balance'; const textOf = (el) => ((el && (el.innerText || el.textContent)) || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const readBalance = () => { const label = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('p')).find((el) => /your balance/i.test(textOf(el))); const card = label ? label.closest('.text-center') : null; const value = card ? textOf(card.querySelector('.text-3xl.font-bold.text-white')) : ''; if (value) return value; const fallback = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.text-3xl.font-bold.text-white')).map(textOf).find((text) => /^\d+(?:\.\d+)?$/.test(text)); return fallback || ''; }; await log('第5步：开始读取 Enderbit 当前 coins 余额，当前地址：' + location.href); const deadline = Date.now() + 20000; let balance = ''; while (Date.now() < deadline) { balance = readBalance(); if (balance) break; await wait(500); } if (!balance) { ctx.variables.enderbitNotifyChatId = notifyId; ctx.variables.enderbitNotifyReason = '余额读取失败'; await log('第5步：未读取到余额，页面摘要：' + textOf(document.body).slice(0, 220)); return 'unknown'; } const currentBalance = Number(balance); const previousRaw = window.localStorage.getItem(notifyKey); const hasPreviousBalance = previousRaw !== null && previousRaw !== ''; const previousBalance = hasPreviousBalance ? Number(previousRaw) : NaN; const shouldNotify = !hasPreviousBalance || !Number.isFinite(previousBalance) || (Number.isFinite(currentBalance) && currentBalance - previousBalance >= notifyStep); if (shouldNotify && Number.isFinite(currentBalance)) { window.localStorage.setItem(notifyKey, String(currentBalance)); ctx.variables.enderbitNotifyChatId = notifyId; ctx.variables.enderbitNotifyReason = hasPreviousBalance && Number.isFinite(previousBalance) ? `余额增长 ${currentBalance - previousBalance} coins` : '首次通知'; await log('第5步：读取到当前余额：' + balance + ' coins；触发通知：' + ctx.variables.enderbitNotifyReason); } else { ctx.variables.enderbitNotifyChatId = ''; ctx.variables.enderbitNotifyReason = Number.isFinite(previousBalance) ? `距离下次通知还差 ${Math.max(0, notifyStep - (currentBalance - previousBalance))} coins` : '余额不是数字'; await log('第5步：读取到当前余额：' + balance + ' coins；不推送：' + ctx.variables.enderbitNotifyReason); } return balance;
